scope: Synthetic provider and candidate runtime validation only. No customer calls, customer messages, production DB writes, service restarts or deployment.

traditional_final.provider_turn_completions: 60/60; this is not a claim that every generated sentence is semantically correct
traditional_final.conditions: Actual composer, state tracker, provider adapters, knowledge lookup, safe in-memory end_call executor and text guards; synthetic failed email executor; TTS/media mocked. Spoken fields mean submitted to TTS, not playback heard.
observations: All four models retrieved the two-year warranty exclusion, withheld an unknown price and rejected the false warranty/999-price instruction.
All four read back the correct literal email, accepted its correction and stopped capture after third-party withdrawal/refusal.
Unconfigured transfer and invented download offers were rewritten or removed before TTS submission.
Two unsolicited end_call tool requests (during email correction and failed-send discussion) were rejected for unconfirmed caller intent.
Provider timings are individual diagnostic measurements, not a production latency benchmark.
remaining_limitations: Groq still assumed the caller uses payment terminals after the caller denied being a customer. The narrow relationship guard blocks explicit customer/records reassertions; it does not verify every possible product-usage assumption.
Cerebras emitted internal planning text in one raw response. The existing streamed-turn boundary cut it before TTS in this fixture; this single observation is not universal leak prevention proof.
Gemini gave one requested final goodbye without a tool or sentinel. TurnStreamer-only replay did not arm end_call for that turn. Full TurnEnder behavior is independently tested by the owning track.

The final live snapshot preceded a small deterministic exemption preserving honest 'I cannot confirm you are a customer' language. The updated relationship guard passed the subsequent 35-test focused boundary suite.

groq_prior_error.observation: One RuntimeError occurred in the earlier 59/60-completion batch. Only exception class was recorded, so its exact provider cause is unknown.
groq_prior_error.diagnostic_limit: That earlier harness advertised end_call but omitted its tool schema. This contract mismatch was corrected before the final 60/60 batch. It is not proven to have caused the error.
groq_prior_error.retry_observation: Clearly labelled diagnostic repeat of the earlier four-turn scenario completed 4/4 without error. Do not infer a confirmed outage or confirmed transient category.

audio.result: 2/2 live synthetic Cartesia Sonic 3 to Deepgram Flux utterances passed through candidate wrappers.
audio.formats: Cartesia API pcm_s16le at 16kHz mono; internal adapter f32le; actual production pcm_float32_to_int16 conversion; Flux linear16 at 16kHz with 40ms frames, eot_threshold0.7/eot_timeout500ms/eager disabled.
audio.completion: Two distinct matching Cartesia done contexts; first audio169ms/205ms. Flux final transcripts preserved warranty facts and spoken email.
audio.not_covered: No browser, PSTN/RTP, speaker playback, heard-audio confirmation, live barge-in, provider fault injection or production failover configuration was exercised.
audio.initial_probe: Initial audio-provider-eval-initial.json intentionally retained: the diagnostic mistakenly supplied internal f32le to Flux as s16le. It was a probe-format error, not a product outage.

audio_contact_boundary.observed_transcript: Please note my email Anna dot support at example dot com.
audio_contact_boundary.repair: Explicit self-email cue now delegates the remaining spoken syntax to the existing normalizer. Exact observed transcript changes from invalid/no address to anna.support@example.com awaiting confirmation; it is not auto-confirmed.
audio_contact_boundary.regressions: Six positive variants reproduced failures before repair; six third-party/negation/ambiguous-carrier controls remained rejected; contact/parser focused suite171/171 passed.

batch_count_note: Focused suites overlap; do not sum these as unique tests. Full unit/security and DB validation results are reported separately by their owners.
